text.text: Claims

What each tool's authors claim, the result that would disprove each claim, and where it stands. 5 tools have claims here. The claims for DIAMOND, Foldseek, phmmer (HMMER 3), MMseqs2 quote the authors' own paper, README or website, with the link; kmerseek's are ours.
Data from 20 Oct 2026, commit 7eca428b (source)
The build recomputes every verdict from the tables or checks it against the recorded notebook output, so nothing on a card is typed in by hand.
DIAMOND
each row: the claim, the result that would disprove it, the verdict with its number, the evidence
○ Not yet tested (1)
Scope and related numbers

The 998 human queries against the 15 relatives, both tools run by the host on Sherlock with their traces. Needs DIAMOND rows (the DIAMOND module, branch olgabot/annotator-tools) and a BLASTP module, which this site does not have yet.

○DIAMOND aligns proteins 100 to 10,000 times faster than BLASTThe authors' words: “Pairwise alignment of proteins and translated DNA at 100x-10,000x speed of BLAST.” (github.com/bbuchfink/diamond, fetched 16 Oct 2026)Disproved if: DIAMOND's CPU-hours per 1,000 queries are more than 1/100 of BLASTP's, on the same queries, relatives and machinenot yet tested · DIAMOND and BLASTP have not been run on the QfO relatives
Foldseek
each row: the claim, the result that would disprove it, the verdict with its number, the evidence
⊘ Disproved (1)
Scope and related numbers

Pfam-A domain instances, raw calls, 998 human queries, the 10 relatives with Foldseek rows (setting 3di_aa against AlphaFold structures). Tests the "sensitive" half only; speed is on the Cost page and is not part of this test. Pfam domains are defined from sequence, which favours sequence searches like phmmer; a structure-based truth set would be the fairer test and is not on this site yet.
Source: seanome/2024-kmerseek-analysis@7eca428b results.parquet

⊘Foldseek is sensitiveThe authors' words: “Foldseek enables fast and sensitive comparisons of large protein structure sets” (github.com/steineggerlab/foldseek, fetched 16 Oct 2026)Disproved if: Foldseek's Fmax on Pfam domains is more than 0.05 below phmmer's, a sequence-only search, on any relative Foldseek searcheddisproved · −0.100 to +0.000 across 10 of 10; furthest: fly −0.100 · leaderboard
phmmer (HMMER 3)
each row: the claim, the result that would disprove it, the verdict with its number, the evidence
⊘ Disproved (1)
Scope and related numbers

Pfam-A domain instances whose closest same-family domain in the relative is 20 to 30% identical, raw calls, 998 human queries; MMseqs2 at sensitivity 7. A relative with fewer than 30 domains in this bin is left out and named in the verdict. The identity bins come from an MMseqs2 search (-s 7.5) between the domains, so a pair MMseqs2 cannot align is in no bin; this favours MMseqs2 in this comparison.
Source: seanome/2024-kmerseek-analysis@7eca428b results.parquet

⊘phmmer finds distant homologs at least as well as a fast sequence searchThe authors' words: “HMMER is designed to detect remote homologs as sensitively as possible” (hmmer.org, fetched 16 Oct 2026)Disproved if: phmmer's Fmax is more than 0.05 below MMseqs2's on Pfam domains at 20 to 30% identity, on any relative with at least 30 such domainsdisproved · −0.137 to +0.057 across 10 of 15 (5 with fewer than 30 truth regions left out: btaurus, mdomestica, mouse, ptroglodytes, rnorvegicus); furthest: ecoli −0.137 · leaderboard

MMseqs2
each row: the claim, the result that would disprove it, the verdict with its number, the evidence
● Holds (1)
Scope and related numbers

"its" in the quote is BLAST. This site does not run BLAST, so phmmer, a full sequence-to-sequence search, stands in for it. Pfam-A domain instances, raw calls, 998 human queries, MMseqs2 at sensitivity 7 (setting s7). Speed is not part of this test.
Source: seanome/2024-kmerseek-analysis@7eca428b results.parquet

●MMseqs2 is almost as sensitive as a full sequence searchThe authors' words: “At 100 times its speed it achieves almost the same sensitivity.” (github.com/soedinglab/MMseqs2, fetched 16 Oct 2026)Disproved if: MMseqs2's Fmax on Pfam domains is more than 0.05 below phmmer's on any of the 15 relativesholds · −0.037 to +0.008 across 15 of 15 · leaderboard
